mapping.summary: Hosted multi-carrier shipping and TMS platform with rate shopping, labels and freight audit
claims: Compares carrier rates per shipment across parcel, LTL, FTL, ocean, rail and air
Live rate shopping, booking and tracking across many carriers
Integrates LTL carriers, brokers, freight forwarders and parcel carriers like FedEx, UPS, USPS and DHL
Pulls posted sales shipments from BC and returns shipping agent, service and tracking number
Produces parcel and return labels, bills of lading, packing slips and commercial invoices
Rules that dispatch orders to carriers automatically
Inbound tracking including live ocean container tracking
Accessorial agent suggests charges like liftgate or residential delivery when a shipment is created
AI agents for load planning, invoice audit, document generation and pickup scheduling
MCP server lets AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot quote, book and track freight
Includes order and warehouse management with picking, receiving and cycle counts
Aimed at shippers with 100 or more shipments a month across several carriers
Over 1,500 ERP, carrier, marketplace and logistics integrations
Also connects to Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management
connectsTo: Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management
